provenance.inputOrigin: A <script setup vapor> SFC and a VDOM SFC passed to a local callable parameter, the shape Vue's FunctionalVaporComponent requires; the fixture workspace carries no Vue package, so the contract is declared in the entry.
provenance.contractOrigin: vue-tsc 3.3.14 types a setup vapor attribute as a bare generic, so the Vapor SFC export is callable and only the VDOM SFC reports TS2345; vize 0.811.0 reported TS2345 for both.

scope: The typecheck-only initial diagnostic packet is the regression contract: the editor types a Vapor SFC's default export as the functional component a Vapor app accepts, and still rejects a VDOM SFC.
